title: Emotional Safety and Wellbeing
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind emotional safety and wellbeing and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply emotional safety and wellbeing in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using emotional safety and wellbeing to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

modules.title: Understanding the Topic
modules.description: Learn what emotional safety and wellbeing means and why it matters for child development.

modules.title: Core Skills and Strategies
modules.description: Explore practical skills and strategies for applying emotional safety and wellbeing in everyday parenting.

modules.title: Real-Life Application
modules.description: See how emotional safety and wellbeing works in real situations with examples and simple scripts.

modules.title: Reflection and Integration
modules.description: Reflect on your learning and plan how to use emotional safety and wellbeing in daily family life.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to emotional safety and wellbeing. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
